status: Rank snapshot candidate passes all nine cup delivery/hold cases. Scalable merge candidate passes isolated, native ordering, preparation, short equivalence and default-off checks. Full merge-candidate cup matrix is running; sustained frame-rate and physical calibration remain unresolved.

rankCupAcceptance.scope: Greedy cup delivery, hold controls, containment and particle inventory. Pressure calibration and contact smoothness are not certified.

deliveryMetric: Original source-pool particles reaching the receiver through both crest and outlet, excluding primer water and rim spills, divided by the initially estimated drainable amount. More than 100 percent means some estimated dead volume also left the source; total particle count remains conserved. It is a volume-equivalent measure, not a requirement that every originally high particle exits.

canonicalOrdering.method: 1024-pair workgroup bitonic sorting followed by binary-search parallel merges, keyed by native segment start and particle ID.
canonicalOrdering.complexity: Worst-case global merge work is O(n log^2 n); the local workgroup network has fixed size. There is no per-bucket all-pairs ranking.

cpuOracle.scope: CPU model of blocked sorting and global merging, including odd tails and repeated sentinels. No GPU performance or physical acceptance.

gpuOracle.scope: Canonical ordering only with actual native dense/sparse builders, negative/nonzero origins, inclusive cull edges, stale IDs, changing counts and merge parity. No physical or frame-rate acceptance.

isolatedRecovery.scope: Native positional recovery only: fixed neighbor lists, exact coincidence, terrain clamps, velocity/material/tail preservation and encoder ordering. It does not certify machine flow or frame rate.

preparationLifecycle.scope: Fault-injected exact preparation function with mocked WebGPU resources. Does not validate shader results or hardware performance.

shortRankMergeEquivalence.test: Prescribed moving immersed guest, fixed dt=1/60, SHA256 of native particles, pressure, gas, phase and geometry buffers.

rows.scope: Full native buffers without moving guest poses.
Full native buffers without moving guest poses.

shortRankMergeEquivalence.limitation: Short deterministic trajectory comparison, not full drainage or natural slime interaction acceptance.

presentationPerformance.limitation: Four sequential 12-second samples after four-second warmups in one owned Chrome for Testing session. These do not establish a statistically reliable speedup, sustained laptop 60 FPS, ordinary-scene performance or a phone tier.
